title: Serve Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 132bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Baseline behind the line
Feet shoulder width
Drop the ball low
Below the waist below

[Whisper verse]
Grip continental neutral
Grip pressure five out of ten
Drop the ball from waist
Let it bounce once chest height

Contact below the waist
Paddle below the wrist
Low to high swing path
Face square at contact

[Tribal drop chant]
Deep deep serve deep
Deep to the line deep to the line
Vamos firme pa lante
Deep deep serve deep

[Whisper verse]
Target the back third
Two feet inside the line
Medium pace top spin light
Clear the net by three feet

Follow through to the shoulder
Return to ready balanced
Step into the court two steps
Breath out and ready eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Deep deep serve deep
Deep to the line deep to the line
Vamos firme pa lante
Deep deep serve deep

[Whisper outro]
Low drop
Deep target
Low drop
Deep target
